comparison: shared-backbone local implementations of the complete label and representation aggregation mechanisms

backbone.features: existing frozen Uni-Mol2 and ESM-2 token means
backbone.input_standardization: training-pair weighted mean and population SD, separately per modality

fixed.search: independent drug, protein, and label searches; combine the representation choices; then two coordinate passes over drug, protein, label using the same grids
fixed.distance: negative squared L2; stable datastore order for ties

adaptive.k: effective k values selected for fixed aggregation on the same validation set
adaptive.selection: lowest full-validation fitting MSE, including initialization
adaptive.distance_scaling: each modality divided by its validation-neighbor RMS distance, floored at 1e-6
adaptive.initialization: zero final weights; prior mass 0.5 on query or model and 0.5 uniformly on neighbors
adaptive.head: frozen, evaluation mode; gradients propagate through inputs

sgf.prior: reuse the existing validation-selected Morgan predictions for each fold
sgf.gate: validation-fit sigmoid(a+b*z); z uses validation sample SD; L2 slope penalty 0.001

aggregation: mean of three seeds within each fold; mean and sample SD over five folds
local_choices: squared L2 convention and stable ties
adaptive optimizer, initialization, distance scaling, and checkpoint selection
test_labels: read only after fitting and parameter selection for a run
